claims.text: Platte Island lies in the Indian Ocean, around 130 kilometers south of Mahé, and is part of the Seychelles Outer Islands.

findings.quote: Situated in the Indian Ocean, around 130 kilometers south of Mahé Island, Platte Island is part of the Seychelles Outer Islands.

claims.text: Platte Island is a sand cay that was originally an uninhabited coconut plantation.

findings.quote: This sand cay was originally an uninhabited coconut plantation

claims.text: Before the flight, an airport concierge escorts guests to the Waldorf Astoria Lounge above the domestic terminal check-in, with WiFi, complimentary drinks and showers.

findings.quote: Before your scenic flight to Platte Island, our airport concierge will escort you to the lounge, where you can relax with unlimited WiFi, complimentary drinks, and shower facilities.
Enjoy access to the exclusive Waldorf Astoria Lounge, located just above the domestic terminal check-in.

claims.text: La Perle offers poolside dining inspired by Northern Mediterranean and Asian cuisines.

findings.quote: Experience elegant poolside dining inspired by Northern Mediterranean and Asian cuisines.

claims.text: Maison Des Epices serves Creole and Latino cooking, with open-fire cooking and handmade spices.

findings.quote: Delight in authentic Creole and Latino traditions, featuring sustainable open-fire cooking and handmade spices.

claims.text: Lalin is a bar with ocean views, an extensive liquor collection and cocktails from sunset.

findings.quote: Enjoy breathtaking ocean views, an extensive liquor collection, and inventive cocktails from sunset to starlight.
For sunset drinks, the Lalin (meaning ‘moon’ in Creole) Bar has elevated views of the ocean

claims.text: Torti serves light lunches, cool drinks and Asian cuisine.

findings.quote: Savor light lunches, enjoy cool drinks, and experience the vibrant flavors of luxurious Asian cuisine.

claims.text: The Waldorf Astoria Spa has six treatment suites.

findings.quote: With six treatment suites, we provide contemporary and traditional therapies, facial and body treatments, and spa rituals.

claims.text: The spa has a hamam, a hydro pool, an infinity pool and a sauna with Himalayan pink salt walls.

findings.quote: It also features a hamam, hydro pool, infinity pool, salons for hair, pedicures and manicures, and a sauna with Himalayan pink salt walls

claims.text: Activities include snorkeling, diving, guided sunrise wildlife walks, sunset yoga and masterclasses.

findings.quote: from snorkeling and diving to guided sunrise wildlife walks, sunset yoga, and exclusive masterclasses.

claims.text: The Sea Scouts Kids Club offers nature-based activities, arts and crafts, and cooking classes.

findings.quote: The Sea Scouts Kids Club offers a range of nature-based activities, plus arts and crafts, and cooking classes.

claims.text: The island is about 95 percent solar-powered.

findings.quote: Platte Island is 95% solar-powered

claims.text: All villa buildings are set back from the beach so hawksbill turtles can keep laying their eggs undisturbed.

findings.quote: All buildings are set back from the beach so that hawksbill turtles can continue laying their eggs undisturbed.

claims.text: The resident environmental manager runs a turtle conservation program and takes guests on early-morning patrols to find and document new nests.

findings.quote: Resident environmental manager Dominique Dina runs the turtle conservation program and takes guests on early-morning ‘patrols’ to find and document new nests.

claims.text: Villas have a large terrace, a private pool and direct beach access from the villa's own garden.

findings.quote: Enjoy spacious accommodations with elegant amenities, a large terrace, and a private pool, alongside direct beach access from your own garden.

claims.text: Champagne Rock is the island's natural beach bar, and floating breakfasts can be served in the villa's private pool.

findings.quote: Whether it’s enjoying a floating breakfast in your private pool or indulging in the unique charm of Champagne Rock, our natural beach bar

claims.text: Moulin uses seasonal produce harvested from the restaurant's own garden.

findings.quote: Savor exclusive dishes and enjoy seasonal produce harvested directly from the restaurant's own garden.

claims.text: The island is reached only by private plane, and the flight is charged for a fee.

findings.quote: Our island is accessible exclusively by private plane flight for a fee.

claims.text: Paths are sandy, which might make wheelchair use hard.

findings.quote: Paths are sandy, which might make it hard to use a wheelchair.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the resort's ultra-luxury positioning.
